[E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
|
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService
|   |-- contexts: CanvasEditingContext -> CanvasHistory
|   |-- openContext / state / resolve / document
|   |-- append / navigate / reset / exportContext / forkContext / adopt
|   |-- persistenceChanges(context, since) -> incremental history records
|   `-- prepareTransfer / prepareTransferNavigation -> coordinated canvases
|
|-- record: CanvasHistoryRecord
|   |-- schemaVersion: 1 / contextId
|   |-- baselineId / headId
|   |-- past[] / future[]                  checkpoint IDs
|   |
|   |-- snapshots[id]: StoredCanvasSnapshot
|   |   |-- id / parentId?
|   |   |-- document: CanvasDocument
|   |   |   |-- scene.root                 instances + layout; diagram IDs
|   |   |   |-- edges[]                    logical content-node references
|   |   |   `-- sections
|   |   |-- diagramBindings               diagramId -> diagramRevisionId
|   |   |-- view                          personal view restoration
|   |   |-- nodeOrigins                   exact proposal provenance
|   |   `-- unresolvedAnchors?            legacy stale-anchor sidecar
|   |
|   `-- diagramRevisions[id]: DiagramRevision
|       |-- id / diagramId / parentId?
|       |-- diagram                       content + sourceContext + jumps
|       `-- nodeRefs                      legacy IDs -> logical IDs
|
|-- diagrams: DiagramRevisionEditor
|   `-- reads revision records + resolves this context's current bindings
|
|-- append(document, view, correspondence)
|   |-- validate before changing canonical state
|   |-- unchanged payload -> reuse diagram revision
|   |-- changed payload -> allocate UUID revision + parent
|   |-- preserve proven node correspondence; encode canonical edges
|   `-- append canvas checkpoint and advance head
|
|-- navigate(redo)
|   `-- move head through past/future; retain stored revisions
|-- edit after undo
|   `-- retain abandoned snapshots; allocate new revision identities
|-- reset()
|   `-- append checkpoint using baseline diagram bindings
|-- fork(view)
|   |-- copy history records; preserve existing diagram revision IDs
|   |-- allocate contextId + captured baseline checkpoint
|   `-- reset past/future; establish baseline node origins
|
`-- compatibility projection: documentFromHistory(...)
    |-- materialize scene.contents[id]: Diagram
    |-- reconstruct legacy revision-bearing endpoints
    `-- feed existing document / rendering / MCP consumers

Portable exports include revision tables and bindings.
DiagramPersistence.persist separates those into diagram records.
Canvas checkpoints retain references; restore expands them.
